referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dense logo-phone header leads into a skyline banner; the main explanation then pairs left technical copy with large HVAC equipment photographs. Dark blue horizontal home, product/service, resource and appointment links below the utility header. Condensed blue uppercase section labels over smaller practical sans body copy. The page sequence runs from utility identity and phone to skyline banner to equipment-and-copy split toward testimonial band, service article cards, contact exit. Denver skyline, HVAC product cutouts and recent service-article thumbnails, with little decorative stock lifestyle imagery. Only transferable composition, hierarchy and service-routing mechanics are retained.
